question: Whose teaching will be presented regarding the fruits of ritual bathing?
premises: The speaker announces intent to tell the fruit of bathing.
The teaching is described as previously said.
Tripurāri is named as the source of that teaching.
inference: The speaker will now explain the fruit of bathing as taught by Tripurāri.
plain_english: Now I shall tell the fruit of bathing, as it was said by Tripurāri.
